user.title: Set up SEKO PoolDose (Live)
user.description: IP address or hostname of the PoolDose. Only checks that the local WebSocket (port 1334) is reachable - does not wait for live data, since the device can legitimately stay silent for several minutes at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the WebSocket on port 1334. Check the IP/hostname.

fw_fallback.title: No mapping for this exact firmware
fw_fallback.description: Model {model} reports firmware {fw_code}, but only a mapping for firmware {used_fw} of the same model was found. Channel names and options should still be correct in most cases (the hash keys are usually stable across firmware updates), but some entities may be missing or mislabeled. Consider contributing a mapping for firmware {fw_code} - see the issue tracker for how.

raw_mode.title: No mapping found for this device
raw_mode.description: No mapping file was found for model {model} (firmware {fw_code}). All channels are shown with generic, hash-based names instead of readable ones (raw_* entities, disabled by default). The integration still works, but consider contributing a mapping - see the issue tracker for how.
